name: WhatsApp Business
description: Typed WhatsApp Cloud API messages, templates, media metadata, phone profiles, registration and offline webhook decoding.

permissions.description: Fixed HTTPS graph.facebook.com/v26.0 only. Externally provisioned WhatsApp Business account, phone and messaging/management scopes required. Bearer access token in Authorization only; registration PIN in Meta-required JSON body only. Exact mutation confirmation, recipient opt-in and window/template attestations; zero retries. Pure webhook decode requires external signature verification. No credential acquisition, subscription/listener hosting, arbitrary hosts, media downloads, binary uploads, account creation, installation or provider calls at build time. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="send-text". EXTERNAL SEND MAY INCUR CHARGES: recipientOptIn=true required; Meta permissions, sender onboarding, destination eligibility and pricing apply. Requires customerServiceWindowOpen=true attesting an open 24-hour customer service window. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. definitions.documentation:
POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="send-template". EXTERNAL SEND MAY INCUR CHARGES: recipientOptIn=true required; Meta permissions, sender onboarding, destination eligibility and pricing apply. Requires templateApproved=true; use an approved locale/template and correct positional or named parameters. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="send-image". EXTERNAL SEND MAY INCUR CHARGES: recipientOptIn=true required; Meta permissions, sender onboarding, destination eligibility and pricing apply. Requires customerServiceWindowOpen=true attesting an open 24-hour customer service window. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="send-audio". EXTERNAL SEND MAY INCUR CHARGES: recipientOptIn=true required; Meta permissions, sender onboarding, destination eligibility and pricing apply. Requires customerServiceWindowOpen=true attesting an open 24-hour customer service window. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="send-video". EXTERNAL SEND MAY INCUR CHARGES: recipientOptIn=true required; Meta permissions, sender onboarding, destination eligibility and pricing apply. Requires customerServiceWindowOpen=true attesting an open 24-hour customer service window. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

definitions.documentation:
POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="send-document". EXTERNAL SEND MAY INCUR CHARGES: recipientOptIn=true required; Meta permissions, sender onboarding, destination eligibility and pricing apply. Requires customerServiceWindowOpen=true attesting an open 24-hour customer service window. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="send-sticker". EXTERNAL SEND MAY INCUR CHARGES: recipientOptIn=true required; Meta permissions, sender onboarding, destination eligibility and pricing apply. Requires customerServiceWindowOpen=true attesting an open 24-hour customer service window. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. definitions.documentation:
POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="send-location". EXTERNAL SEND MAY INCUR CHARGES: recipientOptIn=true required; Meta permissions, sender onboarding, destination eligibility and pricing apply. Requires customerServiceWindowOpen=true attesting an open 24-hour customer service window. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

definitions.documentation:
POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="send-contacts". EXTERNAL SEND MAY INCUR CHARGES: recipientOptIn=true required; Meta permissions, sender onboarding, destination eligibility and pricing apply. Requires customerServiceWindowOpen=true attesting an open 24-hour customer service window. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="send-reaction". EXTERNAL SEND MAY INCUR CHARGES: recipientOptIn=true required; Meta permissions, sender onboarding, destination eligibility and pricing apply. Requires customerServiceWindowOpen=true attesting an open 24-hour customer service window. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

definitions.documentation:
POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="send-buttons". EXTERNAL SEND MAY INCUR CHARGES: recipientOptIn=true required; Meta permissions, sender onboarding, destination eligibility and pricing apply. Requires customerServiceWindowOpen=true attesting an open 24-hour customer service window. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="send-list". EXTERNAL SEND MAY INCUR CHARGES: recipientOptIn=true required; Meta permissions, sender onboarding, destination eligibility and pricing apply. Requires customerServiceWindowOpen=true attesting an open 24-hour customer service window. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/messages. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="mark-read". RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. GET https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{mediaId}. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. GET https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/whatsapp_business_profile. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/whatsapp_business_profile. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="update-profile". RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

GET https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{wabaId}/message_templates. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. GET https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{templateId}. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{wabaId}/message_templates. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="create-template". RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{templateId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="update-template". RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

DELETE https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{wabaId}/message_templates. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="delete-template". RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. definitions.documentation:
GET https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{wabaId}. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

definitions.documentation:
POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/register. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="register-phone". Registration enables/sets two-step verification; externally verify ownership first. Six digit PIN from WHATSAPP_REGISTRATION_PIN is sent only in Meta-required JSON pin field; access token stays in Authorization header. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

definitions.documentation:
POST https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0/{phoneNumberId}/deregister. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="deregister-phone". RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

definitions.description: WhatsApp Decode Incoming Messages And Statuses
definitions.documentation:
Offline decode of already authenticated messages-field webhook JSON; never proves signature authenticity or delivery. RuntimeConnection uses config and credentials.accessToken (apiKey fallback); builtin config.$connection selects a profile. WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret selects external credentials; no login/OAuth/token creation. Exactly one HTTPS call, manual redirects and numeric $retries=0; never automatically retry an uncertain mutation. One bounded page (100 maximum) returns only opaque nextAfter; never follows provider URLs or returns access_token from paging URLs. Media metadata URL is returned but never fetched; no binary upload/download, listener or polling. Known fields only, strict dense JSON, explicit null/falsy preservation, decimal identity strings and exact file_size strings. 512KiB POST,1MiB response,depth35,100000 cells,16384 nonempty chunks,100–30000ms total deadline beginning before profile/secret lookup through cleanup. Provider error bodies and credentials never surface. Sources: https://www.postman.com/meta/whatsapp-business-platform/collection/wlk6lh4/whatsapp-cloud-api https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/api.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/facebook-nodejs-business-sdk/main/src/objects/whats-app-business-account.js https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview https://business.whatsapp.com/policy https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing

definitions.documentation: Event output contract for WhatsApp Text Message Received (Relay). This trigger accepts the canonical version-1 whatsapp-business envelope only; it does not authenticate or decode native provider requests. Required exact provider verification: Verify Meta GET hub.mode/hub.verify_token/hub.challenge ownership handshake, then X-Hub-Signature-256 exact raw-body HMAC with the Meta app secret and authorized WABA/phone-number IDs. The native GET echo does not validate hub.verify_token; keep the entire handshake in the relay. Mapping: Split entry[].changes[].value.messages/statuses. accountId is authorized WABA ID; map phone_number_id, message/status id and timestamp. For text messages map text.body; unsupported message kinds are excluded. Omit sender/recipient phone numbers and contact metadata. Canonical eventType values: message.text. Required envelope: version=1, provider=whatsapp-business, deliveryId, eventType, occurredAt (UTC ISO milliseconds), accountId, resource as the typed output schema. Omit no required fields; use explicit null where allowed. Filters accountId/resourceId are exact matches; blank disables a filter. At most 100 account+delivery IDs within 96 KiB deduplicate retries per group; state commits on trigger success before downstream completion. Verification token ownership check is not supplied by native query echo. Separate relay owns batching, subscription setup and Meta signature/challenge handling. Sources: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/webhooks/ https://github.com/fbsamples/whatsapp-api-examples/tree/main/signature-validation-with-webhooks-payloads

ingressRequirements.name: WhatsApp Business notifications relay
ingressRequirements.description: Manual prerequisite: separately maintained exact provider authentication/normalization relay. This release only accepts header-authenticated canonical envelopes from that relay.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; no relay or subscription is installed.
Deploy an independently maintained provider-aware relay which implements the exact provider signature, challenge, authorization and replay rules described below.

Verify Meta GET hub.mode/hub.verify_token/hub.challenge ownership handshake, then X-Hub-Signature-256 exact raw-body HMAC with the Meta app secret and authorized WABA/phone-number IDs. The native GET echo does not validate hub.verify_token; keep the entire handshake in the relay.

Split entry[].changes[].value.messages/statuses. accountId is authorized WABA ID; map phone_number_id, message/status id and timestamp. For text messages map text.body; unsupported message kinds are excluded. Omit sender/recipient phone numbers and contact metadata.

Implement the exact canonical version-1 envelope and typed resource schemas documented by each selected trigger; forward one event per POST. Normalize account identity from the authorized provider connection, never from an untrusted request.

Persist one stable delivery ID per logical event across relay retries. Fanout IDs must include distinct native entity/event/status identity (or a persisted record ID); reusing a batch delivery ID or message ID across different statuses drops events. Authorize account/resources; bound payloads to 64 KiB and limit rate.
Save a separate relay-to-ONF callback secret; create a header-authenticated ingress profile for this requirement.
Bind the intended trigger node, configure the relay with its HTTPS callback URL, then deliberately enable workflow and entry.
Review relay limits, delivery identifiers, retries and downstream idempotency; test explicitly before production use.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/verified-events"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.

network.purpose: Provider HTTPS callbacks reach the independently deployed relay; ONF uses its existing HTTPS publication.
